# USA.gov

> USA.gov is the official federal government portal providing centralized access to benefits, services, and information across all agencies.

USA.gov serves as the primary digital gateway for citizens to discover and access federal government services, benefits programs, and official information. The site aggregates resources from multiple agencies including Social Security, IRS, Medicare, Medicaid, and the Department of Veterans Affairs, making it easier for Americans to find assistance with health, employment, housing, education, and financial needs.

## Key Topics

- Government benefits
- Social Security
- Medicare and Medicaid
- Federal Student Aid
- IRS and tax filing
- Veteran benefits
- Housing assistance
- Health Insurance Marketplace
- Disability services
- Immigration and citizenship
- Unemployment benefits
- Disaster assistance
- Small business resources
- Identity theft prevention
- Government services directory

## Essential Benefits and Assistance

- [Government benefits](https://www.usa.gov/benefits): SNAP, Social Security, WIC, Medicaid, CHIP and food/housing assistance.
- [Health](https://www.usa.gov/health): Medicare, Medicaid, Health Insurance Marketplace, and mental health support.
- [Education](https://www.usa.gov/education): Federal Student Aid, FAFSA, Head Start, and education assistance programs.
- [Housing help](https://www.usa.gov/housing-help): Housing assistance, Section 8 vouchers, rental programs, and home repairs.
- [Disability services](https://www.usa.gov/disability-services): Disability benefits, SSDI, SSI, employment support, and ADA resources.

## Taxes, Money, and Financial Services

- [Taxes](https://www.usa.gov/taxes): Federal income tax filing, refund status, tax forms, and IRS assistance.
- [Money and credit](https://www.usa.gov/money): Unclaimed money, credit reports, savings bonds, grants, loans, and taxes.
- [Small business](https://www.usa.gov/small-business): Start, fund, and manage businesses; import/export licenses and resources.

## Employment, Military, and Immigration

- [Jobs, labor laws, and unemployment](https://www.usa.gov/jobs-labor-laws-unemployment): Job search, unemployment benefits, labor laws, and retirement planning.
- [Military and veterans](https://www.usa.gov/military-and-veterans): Military enlistment, veteran benefits, Selective Service, and military records.
- [Immigration and U.S. citizenship](https://www.usa.gov/immigration-and-citizenship): Green Cards, visas, citizenship, DACA, and naturalization information.

## Travel, Legal, and Government Information

- [Travel](https://www.usa.gov/travel): Passport applications, REAL ID, visa requirements, and travel documents.
- [Laws and legal issues](https://www.usa.gov/laws-and-legal-issues): Legal aid, vital documents, family law, and crime victim resources.
- [The U.S. and its government](https://www.usa.gov/about-the-us): Overview of U.S. government structure, history, and how to contact officials.

## Emergency Services and Disaster Assistance

- [Disasters and emergencies](https://www.usa.gov/disasters-and-emergencies): Disaster financial assistance, emergency housing, and recovery resources.

## Support and Safety

- [Scams and fraud](https://www.usa.gov/scams-and-fraud): Identity theft, Social Security scams, fraud prevention and reporting.
- [Complaints](https://www.usa.gov/complaints): File complaints about government agencies, services, and consumer issues.
- [Call USAGov](https://www.usa.gov/phone): Contact USAGov agents via phone for federal benefits and services information.

## Optional

- [Innovation](https://www.usa.gov/innovation): Citizen science, challenges, competitions, and volunteer opportunities.
